title: Gerunds vs Infinitives
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has dominado uno de los temas más tramposos del inglés avanzado: los verbos que cambian de significado dependiendo de si usan Gerundio o Infinitivo.

stages.title: Verbos con Cambio de Significado (Gerundio vs Infinitivo)

parts.visual:
Verbos como STOP, REMEMBER, FORGET y REGRET cambian de significado según lo que les siga. 
- Stop + ING (Dejar un hábito): He stopped SMOKING. (Dejó de fumar). 
- Stop + TO (Detenerse para hacer algo): He stopped TO SMOKE. (Se detuvo PARA fumar).
parts.audio: Verbs like stop, remember, forget, and regret, change their meaning depending on what follows them. Stop plus i n g means to quit a habit. For example: He stopped smoking. Stop plus 'to' means to stop an action in order to do something else. For example: He stopped to smoke.

parts.visual:
- Remember/Forget + ING (Recuerdo del pasado): I remember SIGNING the contract. (Recuerdo haberlo firmado). 
- Remember/Forget + TO (Deberes a futuro): Remember TO SIGN the contract. (Acuérdate de firmarlo). 
- Regret + ING (Lamento haber hecho algo): I regret TELLING him. 
- Regret + TO (Lamento informarte): I regret TO TELL you that you are fired.
parts.audio: Remember or Forget plus i n g refers to a memory of the past. For example: I remember signing the contract. Remember or Forget plus 'to' refers to a future duty. For example: Remember to sign the contract. Regret plus i n g means you are sorry for something you did in the past. For example: I regret telling him. Regret plus 'to' is used in formal language to say 'I am sorry to inform you'. For example: I regret to tell you that you are fired.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta (Gerundio o Infinitivo) según el contexto.

questions.question: I completely forgot ____ the client. I'll do it right now! (Olvidé llamarlo - deber futuro/presente).
questions.explanation: Forget + TO = olvidar hacer una tarea o deber.

questions.question: I'll never forget ____ the CEO for the first time. It was terrifying. (Recuerdo la experiencia pasada).
questions.explanation: Forget + ING = olvidar una experiencia que ya viviste en el pasado.

questions.question: Please remember ____ your timesheet before 5 PM. (Acuérdate de enviar - deber).
questions.explanation: Remember + TO = recordar hacer una obligación.

questions.question: I clearly remember ____ that email, but now I can't find it in my sent folder. (Recuerdo haberlo enviado).
questions.explanation: Remember + ING = tener la memoria de algo que ya hiciste.

questions.question: We were driving to the office, but we stopped ____ some coffee. (Nos detuvimos PARA comprar).
questions.explanation: Stop + TO = interrumpir una acción con el propósito de hacer otra.

questions.question: The doctor told him he must stop ____ if he wants to reduce his stress. (Dejar el hábito de trabajar tanto).
questions.explanation: Stop + ING = abandonar un hábito o acción continuada.

questions.question: I regret ____ you that your application has been rejected. (Lamento informarle - formal).
I really regret ____ that job offer. The company is now a unicorn! (Me arrepiento de haber rechazado).
questions.explanation: Regret + ING = arrepentirse de una acción del pasado.

questions.question: We tried ____ the server, but it's still crashing. (Hicimos el experimento de reiniciar).
questions.explanation: Try + ING = hacer un experimento o probar un método para ver si funciona.

questions.question: I tried ____ the server, but I didn't have the admin password. (Hice el esfuerzo pero no pude).
questions.explanation: Try + TO = hacer el intento/esfuerzo de hacer algo, a menudo sin éxito.

questions.question: If your laptop is freezing, try ____ some background apps. (Prueba a cerrar - como solución).
questions.explanation: Try + ING = sugerir un método o experimento.

questions.question: Did you remember ____ the alarm before leaving the office? (Recordaste activar).
I remember ____ the door, but maybe it didn't lock properly. (Recuerdo la acción de cerrar).
Please stop ____! I am trying to focus on this report. (Dejen de hablar - interrumpir la acción).
On my way to the meeting, I stopped ____ up some documents. (Me detuve para recoger).
I regret ____ to that meeting. It was a complete waste of time. (Me arrepiento de haber ido).
The company regrets ____ announce the closure of its Madrid office. (Lamenta anunciar - formal).
Don't forget ____ your password tomorrow morning. It expires today. (No olvides cambiar - deber).
I'll never forget ____ my first bonus. I was so happy! (Olvidar la experiencia de recibir).
We tried ____ the client, but his phone was switched off. (Intentamos contactar - esfuerzo fallido).
questions.explanation: Try + TO (hacer el esfuerzo sin lograrlo).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la forma correcta del verbo entre paréntesis (usando 'to' o '-ing').

questions.question: He stopped ____ (smoke) 5 years ago. (Dejó el hábito)
We stopped ____ (eat) because we were hungry. (Nos detuvimos para)
Remember ____ (lock) the door! (Acuérdate de - deber)
I remember ____ (see) him yesterday. (Recuerdo haberlo visto)
Don't forget ____ (call) the client. (No olvides - deber)
I'll never forget ____ (win) that award. (Experiencia pasada)
I regret ____ (tell) you that you failed. (Lamento informarte)
I regret ____ (buy) this old car. (Me arrepiento de haber comprado)
Try ____ (restart) the PC to see if it fixes it. (Prueba como experimento)
I tried ____ (open) the door, but it was locked. (Hice el esfuerzo físico pero no pude)

pairs.target: Detenerse con el propósito de fumar
Olvidar la experiencia de haber llamado
Hacer el esfuerzo de abrir (pero fallar)
Hacer el experimento de abrir (a ver qué pasa)
